name: Last Memory
source:
—— Life is limited. At the end of the year, I believe that there is a bright smile on the side of the story-

At the end of May, I moved to the high school second grade Miyahi Hikari class. "It's a short while ..."
translation:
——生命终有尽头。我相信，在生命的最后，会有灿烂的笑容——

五月将尽时，高二学生宫野光的班上来了一名转学生。“虽然相处的时间不长…”
